# Attribution

This workspace skill is adapted from the `msresearch-aurora` skill in
[Microsoft Research Vibe Kit](https://github.com/microsoft/vibe-kit), licensed under the MIT
License.

Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.

The adaptation keeps the upstream workflow concepts for Aurora inference, data preparation,
evaluation, fine-tuning, and troubleshooting, while replacing the bundled prototype applications
and large research/data assets with PrevaIQ-specific managed endpoint operations.

No upstream research PDFs, model checkpoints, NetCDF examples, GRIB fixtures, or demo applications
are redistributed here.
